market_summary: FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and Gold (XAUUSD) experienced sharp bearish breakdowns during the London/NY overlap, now consolidating near session lows near lower ATR bands. Meanwhile, US equity indices (US100) and BTCUSD show robust bullish momentum expanding above their respective Value Areas and session VWAPs.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4033.66) and below POC (4043.60). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1.08) with positive short-term slope (+0.93) showing momentum slowing after a massive selloff. SESSION is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price traded far below VWAP (4041.66) and EMA50 (4039.11), penetrating the lower ATR band (4013.59). High RVOL confirmed the downbreak, but price is now stretched near Session Low support (4000.54) with a forming bullish candle. Expecting potential temporary rebound/consolidation.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish breaking sharply below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection near Session Low 4000.54 after breaking Prev Low

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (1.11139) and below POC (1.11376). CVD is BEARISH (-14,562) agreeing with the strong downside trend during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Price remains comfortably below VWAP (1.11314) and EMA50 (1.11307). Price stretched past lower ATR band (1.10960) on yellow RVOL spike. Price is currently consolidating slightly off Session Low (1.10824); entering late after a large move carries unfavorable location risk.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish strong downtrend below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: breakdown below Prev Low 1.11456 bouncing off Session Low 1.10824

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (1.32911) and below POC (1.33475). CVD is BEARISH (-3,591) with positive slope indicating minor short covering during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is below VWAP (1.33113) and EMA50 (1.33127), and close to the lower ATR band (1.32776). The breakdown was confirmed by yellow RVOL spikes, but live price shows a bounce forming off Session Low (1.32661). Risk of chasing at extreme lows makes HOLD prudent.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish sharp downtrend below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: sweep and rebound off Session Low 1.32661

signals.rationale: Price is trading well above VAH (28292.93) and above POC (28272.18). CVD is BULLISH (+10.56) confirming upside pressure during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is well above VWAP (28142.58) and EMA50 (28179.49). Normal US100 Dukascopy tick volume (no yellow RVOL required). Forming candle shows an intrabar dip to 28385.15 after testing Session High (28445.08), near upper ATR band (28399.62). Intrabar pullback offers a strong momentum continuation entry.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish strong trend above VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance above VAH 28292.93 and pullback from Session High 28445.08

signals.rationale: Price is breaking above VAH (73869.38) and above POC (73650.62). CVD is BEARISH (-0.06) but virtually flat/NEUTRAL relative to session. SESSION is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is above VWAP (73683.60) and EMA50 (73716.12). Price is expanding toward the upper ATR band (74310.42). Signal bar and forming bar demonstrate strong green momentum pushing past local resistance S/R (73975.30) to test 74085.20.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish price reclaiming above VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance back above VAH 73869.38 and testing S/R 74085.20
